meta.title: Workspace sidebar
meta.description: Ties the right sidebar's file tree to the workspace of the conversation you are reading, in five parts. First, opening a conversation shows that workspace's file tree in the right sidebar automatically; once you close it, that conversation stays closed for the rest of the page load. Second, the right sidebar keeps the width you drag it to, across reloads and restarts; until you drag it, it opens at about 26% of the viewport. Third, dragging a file or folder from the tree onto the composer inserts it as an @ reference. Fourth, workspaces are reordered by their most recent conversation, and each workspace's menu offers "Pin workspace to top", which outranks that recency. Fifth, each conversation row shows a whale-tail pixel face for "needs you", "working", or "finished"; an idle conversation shows none, and the row menu can pin any of the seven faces as a bookmark. Sixth, each workspace row summarises the conversations under it and shows the most urgent face among them, clearing it when none remain. Windows narrower than 768px never open the sidebar unasked. The first three can be adjusted in Settings → General; the workspace order follows the plugin switch. The plugin makes no network requests; its data stays in this browser's local storage.
